AdmissionBypass.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks that transactions using the early channel can complete while a
   producer's contiguous admission frontier remains blocked by a missing
   entry. *)

AdmissionCapabilities.tla.inserted_header:
(* Runs physical admission with compact certificate identities, checking
   full receipt evidence at emission before discarding the certificate's
   proof payload. *)

AdmissionCapabilityCorrespondence.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks the certificate-capability reduction against reachable fine
   admission states, comparing normalized actions and message deliveries. *)

AdmissionCold.tla.inserted_header:
(* Exercises a holder that loses both stored payloads and local
   authorization, then recovers authority from the journal before rebuilding
   a valid copy. *)

AdmissionCompact.tla.inserted_header:
(* Runs the admission protocol with obsolete send-suppression flags removed,
   retaining physical copies, messages and certificate evidence. *)

AdmissionCorrespondence.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks that forgetting obsolete admission send flags preserves the
   normalized successors of each fine protocol action and message delivery. *)

AdmissionEvidence.tla.inserted_header:
(* Distinguishes historical certificate evidence from simultaneous copy
   survival, including histories whose losses exceed the promised protection
   allowance. *)

AdmissionFrontiers.tla.inserted_header:
(* Explores the abstract certificate service: out-of-order certification,
   contiguous per-stream frontiers, generation renewal and bounded loss. *)

AdmissionHistories.tla.inserted_header:
(* Drives selected admission histories through frontier holes, independent
   streams, repair and producer rediscovery. The causal schedule is
   authored. *)

AdmissionInertCorrespondence.tla.inserted_header:
(* Audits the inert-message/send reduction against fine admission states,
   checking exact normalized successors and permanence of discarded
   deliveries. *)

AdmissionInertNetwork.tla.inserted_header:
(* Runs folded-journal admission after removing permanently inert messages
   and send flags. Correspondence audits justify this smaller
   representation. *)

AdmissionMaterial.tla.inserted_header:
(* Composes physical payload admission with journal service and an
   independent certificate observer, checking custody, frontiers, renewal
   and recovery. *)

AdmissionUnsafeNetworkProbe.tla.inserted_header:
(* Negative control: exposes why a duplicate payload cannot be discarded
   merely because its destination has a copy now; a later loss may need it. *)

AdmissionUnsafeProducer.tla.inserted_header:
(* Deliberately unsound reduction that also forgets producer submission
   flags. Their identities omit the generation, so forgetting can enable new
   work. *)

AdmissionUnsafeProducerCorrespondence.tl.inserted_header:
(* Negative correspondence check for forgetting producer submission flags;
   renewal exposes newly enabled submissions absent from the fine state. *)

AdmissionUnsafeSendCorrespondence.tla.inserted_header:
(* Negative correspondence check for erasing all send-suppression flags,
   including flags whose deliveries still change protocol state. *)

AdmissionUnsafeSends.tla.inserted_header:
(* Deliberately unsound variant of the inert-send reduction that erases
   every packet suppression flag, used to test the correspondence check. *)

AuthorityBootstrapSOS.tla.inserted_header:
(* Joins journal authority, retained material and SOS export/reconciliation
   in authored histories, separating recoverable bytes from permission to
   serve. *)

BootstrapDiscovery.tla.inserted_header:
(* Exercises bootstrap from empty inventories using journal snapshots and
   holder exports, including a root created during discovery and observer
   restart. *)

BootstrapUnderPressure.tla.inserted_header:
(* Runs bootstrap discovery through counted recovery resources and backend
   retirement while ordinary capacity is occupied. *)

CheckedViews.tla.inserted_header:
(* Joins transactions, retention roots and physical views to check captured
   reads, independent verification and publication of the correct bytes. *)

CompletionUnderPressure.tla.inserted_header:
(* Joins journal persistence and retained-material work with capacity
   leases, checking that completion paths keep their resources through
   physical retirement. *)

DeliveryDataflow.tla.inserted_header:
(* Explores logical delivery across duplicate routes, representations,
   dynamic children, late recipients, cancellation and source/recipient
   recovery. *)

DeliveryRetention.tla.inserted_header:
(* Connects delivery coverage and application completion to actual retained
   roots, custody transfer and collection, including cancellation and late
   enrollment. *)

DeliveryUnderPressure.tla.inserted_header:
(* Charges delivery work to resource leases and backend operations, checking
   progress and physical lifetime through replay, cancellation and dynamic
   recipients. *)

DerivedDelivery.tla.inserted_header:
(* Derives delivery contributions from actual transaction/interpreter
   outputs and chosen outcomes, checking stable identity through replay and
   late enrollment. *)

DurableLogService.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks the abstract journal service's duplicate-command handling, local
   delivery and recovery snapshots using distinct envelopes for one
   immutable command. *)

EarlyDispatch.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks at-most-once early dispatch using durably assigned disjoint
   ranges, including driver loss, replacement and delayed attempts from an
   old driver. *)

EffectKernel.tla.inserted_header:
(* Models journaled external-effect intents and sink delivery, preserving
   stable identity and explicit uncertainty when a non-deduplicating sink
   loses its reply. *)

EpochExecution.tla.inserted_header:
(* Compares independently scheduled consumers of agreed epochs using the
   application interpreter, including dynamic continuations and logical
   output closure. *)

EpochTransactionFolds.tla.inserted_header:
(* Compares complete transaction folds over agreed batches, including
   logical outputs and independent progress; smaller products audit the
   scheduling reduction. *)

ExternalEffects.tla.inserted_header:
(* Connects committed transaction intents to the effect journal and external
   sink, exercising driver reset and lost replies with and without sink
   deduplication. *)

HistoricalSnapshot.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks reads at an explicitly requested historical cut against retained
   bytes and supplied freshness requirements, including agreed
   unavailability. *)

IndependentTransactions.tla.inserted_header:
(* Requires a real transaction to commit while another transaction's remote
   read remains withheld forever, detecting unnecessary global progress
   barriers. *)

JournalAuthority.tla.inserted_header:
(* Exercises the concrete journal provider across persistence, recovery and
   authority transfer, comparing its observations with the abstract service
   and order contracts. *)

JournalIngress.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks concrete follower ingress and command deduplication when two
   different submission envelopes carry the same immutable frontier command. *)

JournalKernel.tla.inserted_header:
(* Shared concrete journal protocol: quorum persistence, local learning,
   replay, compaction and authority handoff, with explicit storage and
   process failures. *)

MaterialTransfer.tla.inserted_header:
(* Exercises retained-byte custody transfer and actual source deletion,
   including representation conversion, reset during copying and lost hold
   receipts. *)

PendingCutTransfer.tla.inserted_header:
(* Transfers a retained cut's fallback bytes and pending source obligation
   between owners, then checks the same read after source resolution and
   replay. *)

PolicyTxBinding.tla.inserted_header:
(* Binds reservation policies to the actual transaction kernel and journal
   replay, checking serial meaning and deterministic grant closure in
   selected histories. *)

PreparedRootFusion.tla.inserted_header:
(* Compares explicit root acquisition with acquisition from an existing
   same-owner prepared record, including cancellation, missing material and
   recovery cuts. *)

RecipeDependencies.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks that retention recipes are grounded in reconstructible bytes;
   dependency declarations and cycles alone cannot create material. *)

RecoveryCut.tla.inserted_header:
(* Exercises transaction restoration from durable checkpoints and journal
   cursors, including point-in-time recovery, lineage fencing and abandoned
   future work. *)

RecoveryCutKernel.tla.inserted_header:
(* Models checkpoint publication, closed recovery cuts and restoration
   fences, distinguishing durable reconstruction data from authority to
   resume effects. *)

RecoveryMaterial.tla.inserted_header:
(* Explores root acquisition, holder persistence and collection with actual
   recipe bytes, including reset, abort and transfer variants. *)

RecoveryServiceKernel.tla.inserted_header:
(* Shared counted recovery-service path using capacity leases and backend
   completion/retirement, with ordinary resources already occupied. *)

ReopenedWriter.tla.inserted_header:
(* Exercises a writer reopened from retained data and replayed decisions,
   checking commit or undo bytes when a private physical image has been
   lost. *)

ReservationAcquisition.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks multi-shard reservation acquisition and cancellation under
   competing local policies, including reversed acquisition order as a
   deadlock control. *)

ReservationCycle.tla.inserted_header:
(* Explores continuing narrow arrivals around a broad reservation,
   distinguishing starvation from useful progress without recycling full
   transaction identities. *)

ReservationDynamic.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks reservation folds under dynamic enqueue/fix/cancel histories,
   duplicate commands and replica reset, comparing reconstructed state and
   outputs. *)

ReservationReplay.tla.inserted_header:
(* Compares reservation state and emitted grants after replicas consume the
   same authored command history, with duplicate delivery and reset
   variants. *)

ReservationShapes.tla.inserted_header:
(* Compares reservation policies on authored bridge, chain, younger-request
   and cancellation histories, checking which independent work may bypass a
   waiter. *)

RestorationMaterial.tla.inserted_header:
(* Extends recovery-cut restoration with actual retained checkpoint
   material, separating readable state, permission to write and restored
   redundancy. *)

RestoredEffects.tla.inserted_header:
(* Joins restored transaction state with external-effect replay, preserving
   intent identity and uncertainty across normal and point-in-time recovery. *)

RetainedTransactions.tla.inserted_header:
(* Connects transaction reads to retained versions and pending source
   obligations, checking exact-cut bytes or justified failure under
   collection. *)

RootCustodyRecovery.tla.inserted_header:
(* Exercises custody transfer with cold loss of either root owner, requiring
   replay and surviving holder evidence before old custody can retire. *)

RootOwnerRecovery.tla.inserted_header:
(* Crashes a root owner at selected acquisition or retirement cuts, checking
   reconstruction from chosen records while surviving holders keep their
   state. *)

RootRecoveryIdentity.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks that concurrent root-owner recovery requests remain distinct when
   different owners share the same local recovery counter. *)

SOSUnderPressure.tla.inserted_header:
(* Runs SOS pause, export and reconciliation through reserved recovery
   resources, checking physical completion and retirement under ordinary
   load. *)

ScopeRetention.tla.inserted_header:
(* Keeps an old-cut retention obligation through scope migration and new-map
   execution, then checks that the original reader still observes its
   captured bytes. *)

TerminalFloor.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks terminal-attempt compaction against an uncompressed reference,
   preserving unresolved holes and rejection of delayed work after recovery. *)

TransactionEpoch.tla.inserted_header:
(* Connects the transaction protocol to independently stepped application
   interpreters, checking shared context, reports and verified publication
   across epochs. *)

TransactionMachine.tla.inserted_header:
(* Explores the shared transaction kernel with selectable journal service
   and delivery scheduling, comparing reads, outcomes and publication with a
   serial oracle. *)

TransactionRefinement.tla.inserted_header:
(* Checks a small concrete transaction model against eager delivery of
   positive facts, preserving observable protocol steps while hiding
   delivery-only differences. *)

TxFixtures.tla.inserted_header:
(* Defines finite transaction workloads and their parameters for shared
   protocol models, including conflicts, programs, checks and fault
   variants. *)

VersionedExecution.tla.inserted_header:
(* Connects journal-selected execution profiles to actual retained code and
   physical views, including synchronous checking and delayed audit
   retention. *)

ViewsKernel.tla.inserted_header:
(* Shared physical-view operations for scoped reads/writes, version
   reconstruction and backend lifetimes; compositions supply retained
   material and decisions. *)
